purpose: Expose a small MV mental model to agents and users without replacing canonical machine stages.

authority.rule: Macro phases are derived views only. They never authorize a transition, waive an artifact, or replace canonical validation.

principles: Keep machine enforcement granular; keep agent attention coarse.
The agent reasons primarily about the current macro phase and current task, not the entire S00-S18 chain.
Canonical Runtime remains final authority for legal next actions.
A macro phase change is derived from canonical stage state, never manually asserted.

phases.label: Lock the exact sound truth
phases.outcome: Exact song/excerpt identity and trusted lyric/music timeline are locked.

phases.label: Turn lyrics into producible visual intent
phases.outcome: Natural beats, director allocation, and accepted visual anchors are ready.

phases.label: Produce usable source material
phases.outcome: Generated sources have usable windows, material roles, and required normalization/revalidation.

phases.label: Assemble picture and subtitles
phases.outcome: Picture rhythm is accepted and subtitle implementation is technically valid.

phases.label: Validate, release, and close the loop
phases.outcome: Final media is validated, accepted, released, and optionally synchronized with publish data.
